5224.title: Account pool exhaustion diagnostic omits known recovery time
5224.rootCauseOneLine: The hub computes the earliest eligible-account timestamp for Retry-After but discards it when constructing the error message.
5224.proposedFix: Include the existing earliest known availability timestamp and matching delay in the 429 message; preserve the fallback when no reset is known.
5224.caveats: Synthetic upstream HTTP responses exercise the real plugin and hub. No real OAuth quota was consumed. Both clean runs were performed by the same agent.
